messages.author: 20c6dbb46920d12c
messages.subject: breaks with summary stat
parts:
Hi all,

Was having small trouble creating breaks on summarized data in ranges outside the summary stat(s). I'm guessing it could be a result of v0.9's no longer defaulting to the data's range? 


My apologies if this has been addressed previously.


Example
tst<-data.frame(x="Cat",y=rnorm(1000,.9,1))

ggplot(tst,aes(x,y))+
stat_summary(fun.data="mean_cl_boot",geom="pointrange",conf.int=.99)+
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0.85,1.15))+
labs(y="CCF Mean CI (99%)")+
geom_hline(yintercept=1,lt=2)+
scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0.9,0.95,1,1.05,1.1))

compare to....

ggplot(tst,aes(x,y))+
stat_summary(fun.data="mean_cl_boot",geom="pointrange",conf.int=.99)+
coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0.85,1.15))+
labs(y="CCF Mean CI (99%)")+
geom_hline(yintercept=1,lt=2)+
scale_y_continuous(breaks=c(0.9,0.95,1,1.05,1.1))+
geom_point(aes(x=1,y=1.13))
